name: Zettai Ryouiki!
source:
One day, the main character is asked for a 3-on-3 date. When he meets them, he finds all girls wear a miniskirt and knee-high socks. As he hears them enthusiastically talking about "zettai ryouiki", he gradually gets interested in it. When they arrive at a theme park, they start going around in pairs. He is confused at first, but he gradually loosens up with her and his eyes are glued to "zettai ryouiki". When they are on a Ferris wheel, she tells him that she loves him. As a matter of fact, this date was planned for her. He likes her as well, so they decide to date for a week as a test. She aggressively approaches him from the next day. As he dates with her, he gets addicted to "zettai ryouiki" and fully enjoys it. Well, what will happen to their love one week later...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天，主角受邀參加三男三女的聯誼。見面後，他發現所有少女都穿著迷你裙和及膝襪。聽著她們興致勃勃地談論「絕對領域」，他也漸漸產生興趣。抵達遊樂園後，眾人開始分成兩人一組，各自去玩。主角起初有些不自在，卻逐漸和同行的女孩熟絡起來，目光也牢牢被她的「絕對領域」吸引。在摩天輪上，少女向他告白。事實上，這次聯誼正是專門為她安排的。主角也喜歡她，於是兩人決定先試著交往一週。從第二天起，她便開始積極主動地接近他。在約會過程中，主角逐漸迷上「絕對領域」，盡情享受其中樂趣。一週後，他們的愛情會迎來怎樣的結果……？
